# Overlay and Edge Notes

> Field notes by Eugene Armstead (https://www.armsteadent.com/). Living specs with stable IDs. CC-BY-4.0. Placeholders only: <cloud-vps>, <lan-pi>, <overlay-peer>, <exit-node>, <wg-iface>, <gcp-nic>.

- [OEN-17 Google Cloud overlay exit (IP forwarding, listen port, Identity-Aware Proxy)](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/networking/17-gcp-overlay-exit.html): living spec

- [OEN-08 Do not ship localhost debug beacons in Worker HTML](https://eugenearmstead.github.io/overlay-and-edge-notes/web/08-worker-html-localhost-debug.html): living spec
